notes.title: Ant War: Domination trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
We have released the official Ant War: Domination trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 8 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 3 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Build your ant colony in Ant War: Domination and start collecting the trading cards today!
